topics.name: Runner Execution Identity
topics.purpose: Define each concrete Runner invocation as an explicit execution identity separate from the reusable Runner/Routine definition.

semantics.definition_rule: Runner/Routine definition identity is stable and reusable.
semantics.execution_rule: Every concrete invocation receives a distinct execution identity.
semantics.parent_rule: Execution records the exact invoking Event/Trigger/command/parent-run ref where applicable.
semantics.snapshot_rule: Execution binds to the exact canonical/runtime snapshot under which it ran.
semantics.actor_rule: Caller/session/authority context is explicit where governed.
semantics.time_rule: Start/end/status metadata belongs to execution identity, not definition.
semantics.result_rule: Execution result and emitted Events reference the execution identity.

invariants.rule: Runner definition, runner execution, individual step execution, operation dispatch and emitted Events are distinct explicit identities connected by traceable execution/causality relations.

execution has no invoking source ref
